modeHint.open: All tasks are available by default. Students can do every task right away.
modeHint.interval: A new task opens after the set number of days.
modeHint.progressive: A new task opens after the previous one is completed.
modeHint.closed: All tasks are closed by default. The teacher opens tasks for students manually.
modeHint.weekdays: A new task opens only on the chosen days of the week.

marathons.scheduleRule: Each student's schedule counts from the later moment: the marathon start or the day the student was added. The first lesson opens at that moment, the next ones by the schedule in the marathon time zone.
marathons.lessonOpenDateNotUsed: This passing mode does not use lesson opening dates
marathons.teacherCheckHint: The student sends the lesson for review and the teacher completes it. While the lesson is under review, answers cannot be changed.
marathons.teacherCheckNotice: Turning the review on or off does not reset lesson statuses: sent lessons stay under review.
marathons.unlockAfterHint: The next lesson opens when the teacher completes the previous one, or right after the previous lesson is sent for review. If the teacher cancels the completion, with “After the teacher's review” the next lesson closes again.
marathons.lockPreviousReview: Opens after the teacher reviews the previous lesson
marathons.lockPreviousSubmission: Opens after the previous lesson is sent for review
marathons.notCompletedText: Finish this lesson and send it to the teacher for review?

marathons.submittedToast: The lesson has been sent for review
marathons.awaitingStudentText: You have sent this lesson to the teacher for review. While the teacher reviews it, answers cannot be changed. The status will update on this page.
marathons.revisionTitle: The lesson was returned for revision
marathons.revisionStudentText: The teacher returned the lesson. Correct the wrong answers and send the lesson again. Correct answers stay fixed.
marathons.completedByTeacherStudent: The teacher marked this lesson as completed
marathons.completedByTeacher: You marked this lesson as completed
marathons.awaitingTeacherText: The student sent this lesson to you for review. Review it and complete it or return it for revision.
marathons.revisionConfirmText: The lesson goes back to the student. Answers checked as wrong become editable again; correct ones stay fixed.
marathons.revisionToast: The lesson was returned for revision
marathons.revisionTeacherText: The lesson is with the student for revision. After correcting it, the student will send it again. You can also complete it now.
marathons.ratingHint: The student will see the rating and the comment.

marathons.cancelNextLocked: In this marathon the next lesson opens after the teacher's review: it closes again for the student until the lesson is completed again.
marathons.noSubmissionText: The student has not sent the lesson for review yet.
marathons.selfCompletedText: The student completed the lesson without the teacher's review.
marathons.checkOffNotice: Teacher review is off now. You can still decide on a lesson that was already sent.

marathons.studentsRatingHint: Students see places by total points. Students deactivated manually or by their access period are not rated.
marathons.showPlaceHint: A student outside the shown places sees their own place only with “Show”. Equal points share a place.
marathons.statsDisabledText: Statistics is turned off in this marathon. You can turn it on in the marathon settings.
marathons.statsNoStudents: There are no students in the marathon yet
marathons.statsNote: Points are counted from answers in all marathon lessons. “Lessons completed” are lessons completed in the current passage mode. Deactivated students are shown but not rated.
marathons.ratingShown: Places up to {n} of {total} students are shown
marathons.statsCommentHint: Students of this marathon will see the comment in the lesson results. It is not shown in other classes that use this lesson.
marathons.myResultsStatsOff: Points and the rating will appear when the teacher turns on statistics.

marathons.previewResetText: All your preview answers in this lesson will be reset, and the exercises can be taken again. Students' answers and results will not change.
marathons.previewFinishNote: In the preview the lesson is not completed or sent for review: the student does these steps.

boards.name: Board name
boards.empty: You have no interactive boards yet. Create the first one to draw and write on it.

hints.select: Click an object to select it; drag to move it; the corner square resizes it. Double-click to edit text. Delete removes it.
hints.hand: Drag the board to move the visible area. Objects stay where they are.
hints.pen: Draw with a mouse, pen or finger. Ctrl+Z — undo, Ctrl+Shift+Z — redo, Ctrl+S — save.
hints.text: Click the board, type the text and press Enter. Esc — cancel.
hints.sticky: Click the board to stick a note and write on it. Ctrl+Enter — done.
hints.rect: Drag out a rectangle or just click the board.
hints.ellipse: Drag out an ellipse or just click the board.
hints.arrow: Draw the arrow from its start to its end.

boards.openInClassHint: The board appears in the lesson of the chosen class. The student sees it and your changes without reloading but cannot draw. While the board is open in a class, changes are saved automatically.
boards.noClasses: You have no classes for lessons yet.
boards.openInClassNotice: The board is open in «{name}». Changes are saved automatically and the student sees them at once.
boards.closedInClass: The board is closed in the class. It stays in «Materials».
boards.autosaveHint: The board is open in this lesson: changes are saved automatically and the student sees them at once.
boards.viewOnlyHint: The teacher leads the board. Changes appear by themselves, no need to reload the page.
boards.notOpenInClass: the teacher has not opened a board yet
boards.noStudents: There are no students in the class.
boards.drawersHint: By default a student only watches. With permission they get the pen and colours; the permission ends when the board is closed or replaced.
boards.canDrawHint: The teacher let you draw: pen and colours. Strokes are saved at once and the teacher sees them.
